component.name: Tansu
component.summary: A floating shelf for files, text and images

description.p: Tansu is a small floating shelf window where you temporarily park files, text snippets and images during drag-and-drop, so you can navigate freely between windows and workspaces before dropping the items at their final destination.

ul.li: Drop files, text and images onto the shelf
Drag items back out to any app that accepts them
Files are followed when renamed or moved, and removed when deleted
